Awesome Mac
===
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use. As it continues to grow, the project has far exceeded our initial expectations and has become more comprehensive and refined.

Feel free to star ⭐ and fork 🍴 to support the project!

If you have any suggestions, ideas, or discover excellent software, feel free to submit a PR to help improve this list. Please read the contributing guidelines before contributing. We also welcome you to continue following this awesome list to build a better macOS tool collection together.

install.title: Download Management Tools
install.html:
• aria2 - Lightweight multi-protocol & multi-source command-line download utility.
  • Arroxy - Open-source yt-dlp GUI for downloading video, audio, playlists and subtitles from YouTube and other supported sites.
  • Convoy - Open-source download manager with segmented downloads, browser integration, and HLS and DASH stream support.
  • Downie - Video downloader for macOS with support for YouTube and other 1200 sites.
  • Deluge - Deluge is a lightweight, Free Software, cross-platform BitTorrent client.
  • FOLX - Free download manager for Mac OS X with a true Mac-style interface.
  • Free Download Manager - A powerful, easy-to-use, and completely free download accelerator and manager.
  • Harbor - Open-source download manager for HTTP(S), magnet links, and .torrent files.
  • JDownloader - Open-source download manager for links, files, and hosted content.
  • Motrix - Download manager for HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, magnet links, and more.
  • Multron Download Manager - Multi-connection download manager with yt-dlp and BitTorrent support.
  • Neat Download Manager - Lightweight download manager with an optimized transfer engine.
  • Prism - Open-source download manager that splits files into parallel connections, catches browser downloads, and saves videos.
  • qBittorrent - A project aims to provide an open-source software alternative to µTorrent.
  • Shandian - Native download manager that handles magnet links, torrents, HTTP files and videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu in one window, with browser download takeover and stream-while-downloading (Chinese UI).
  • Shuttle - Easy Download Manager for any links.
  • Swads - Synology Download Station Client, modern, native, and intuitively redesign.
  • TBD - Open-source YouTube video and audio downloader built on yt-dlp, which a phone on the same Wi-Fi can also drive.
  • Transmission - Fast, easy, free BitTorrent Client.
  • XGetter - Media downloader for video and audio from major websites.
  • You-Get - Tiny command-line utility to download media contents (videos, audios, images) from the web.
  • youtube-dl - Command-line program to download videos from YouTube.com and other video sites
